name: Arena Master
summary: At the Stranglethorn Arena, Short John Mithril may know what more mastering its contests requires.

sections.title: Seeking the Pirate
sections.body: You have gained something at Gurubashi, yet mastering the arena asks for more. Short John Mithril organizes the contests and may know what is needed. Find him inside the Stranglethorn Arena.

sections.title: Short John's Word
sections.body: Short John Mithril tells you that one trinket is not enough to master the arena. The true proving of your steel begins now.

faq.q: Who do I need to speak with?
faq.answer: Speak with Short John Mithril, the Pirate behind the Gurubashi event.
Find Short John Mithril in the Stranglethorn Arena at Gurubashi in Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: What is hinted about being master of the arena?
faq.answer: You have done something at Gurubashi, yet mastering the arena seems to ask for more. Short John Mithril, the Pirate behind the event, may know what is needed.
